title: ToolResult
description: Params out for every tool this server exposes: an MCP CallToolResult carrying a handle, never bytes. `content` mirrors `structuredContent` as text because client support for structured output is uneven, and adds a resource_link when the result names a file.

content.description: At least one text block holding the JSON payload, optionally followed by a resource_link to the file on disk. Never an image or blob: a tool result is model context, and a GLB is megabytes.

structuredContent.description: The payload. Every asset-bearing tool includes id, path and previewUrl; a caller turns an id into a link with previewUrl and into bytes with the path.

id.description: Stable handle: the file stem folded to a URL-safe alphabet, the same id the preview layer serves under ?id=.

path.description: Absolute path of the file on disk.

isError.description: true when the tool failed in a way the model should read and retry from, rather than a protocol error.
